# ProKit Studio Public Docs

Use this folder for the buyer/operator-facing documentation path.

Read in this order:

1. `docs/public/overview.md`
2. `docs/public/development.md`
3. `docs/public/database.md`
4. `docs/public/scripts.md`
5. `docs/public/deployment.md`
6. `docs/public/optional-features.md` if you enable optional services
7. `docs/public/features.md` to confirm what ships by default

Reference docs:

- `docs/public/architecture.md`
- `docs/public/stack.md`

Maintainer-only notes and internal setup instructions are intentionally separate from this public docs contract.
